blogs.title: GLP-1 Agonists and Muscle: A Call for Expanded Pharmacovigilance in Metabolic Care
blogs.description: As GLP-1 receptor agonists like semaglutide gain traction for obesity and diabetes, this case highlights a distinct adverse effect profile. This post discusses the need for clinicians to remain vigilant for idiosyncratic immune-mediated disorders beyond typical GI intolerance, ensuring early detection of immunologic muscle injury.

blogs.title: Don't Ignore the Dysphagia: Recognizing Dysphagia as an Early Myopathy Clue
blogs.description: Proximal weakness is typical of myopathy, but dysphagia and dysphonia can signal bulbar involvement in severe cases. This review focuses on recognizing these subtle autonomic/distinctive symptoms in metabolic patients, often overlooked in favor of simpler neurologic explanations.

blogs.title: The Seronegative Challenge: Diagnosing Necrotizing Myopathy without Anti-HMGCR/SRP
blogs.description: While anti-HMGCR and anti-SRP are hallmarks of statin/myopathy, not all immune-mediated necrotising myopathy cases are antibody-positive. This post analyzes the diagnostic utility of muscle biopsy in seronegative cases to guide immunosuppression decisions without waiting for specific autoantibody panels.

blogs.title: Rhabdomyolysis vs. Myopathy: Decoding the CK Kinetics in Drug Toxicity
blogs.description: Elevated creatine kinase (CK) is common in metabolic patients, but the timeline of elevation distinguishes the injury. This guide compares the rapid return to baseline seen in direct toxic rhabdomyolysis against the progressive elevation over months seen in immune-mediated processes, aiding in rapid stratification.

blogs.title: Immunosuppression and Withdrawal: The Dual Strategy for Drug-Induced Myopathy
blogs.description: Successful treatment of drug-induced myopathy requires balancing aggressive immunosuppression with early cessation of the offending agent. This post outlines the clinical course of steroid and IVIG weaning supported by drug discontinuation, contributing to functional recovery.
